# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

  # Issue #433: flutter_app CRAP ratchet — the app's beasts were never
  # gated (the root crap4dart.yaml covers core lib/bin only). The 2
  # flutter-tests shards above now emit --coverage; this job merges them

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

arguments.content:
# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

The guard: scan `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` and `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`:

Implementation approach for parsing: find each occurrence of `JsonWidgetRenderer(`, then scan forward to the matching closing paren (balance parens, careful about parens inside strings/comments — the argument lists contain nested parens like `const FaMediaHost()`, lambdas etc.). Simple paren balance works if I ignore string literals... The args contain strings? In js_app_view: no string literals inside the renderer args except maybe none. In dynamic_widget_tile: none either. But `// comments` contain parens? The wiring comments: "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got (see JsAppEngine.start)" — parens in comments! A naive paren counter would count those. So I should strip line comments first (lines have `// ...` comments). String literals with `//` inside could break stripping, but in these specific files, the renderer arg regions don't contain multi-line strings with `//`. To be safe: strip `//`-to-end-of-line comments (not inside strings — accept the tiny risk; if a future string contains `//` the guard may mis-slice, and the test would fail loudly, which is acceptable for a pin guard — it errs on the side of attention).

  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation

  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.

  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get
      # The guard resolves true on macOS (JavaScriptCore), so the
      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

# PR leg never EXERCISES the JS-engine suites: flutter_app/test/apps/**
  # skip their engine-dependent tests on ubuntu (native_test_guard.dart
  # finds no QuickJS .so on a bare runner), so that surface ran only in the
  # nightly macOS leg — the hole #1309 escaped through (gh-1307: an
  # apps/engine regression merged green and went red the same night).
  #
  # Trigger model (dispatch-only CI, gh-1280 binaries-pr idiom): ci.yml has
  # NO pull_request trigger — PR validation arrives as an SM
  # workflow_dispatch on the head SHA (machine-sm.yml), where the paths
  # classifier cannot run (no pull_request event diff). The leg is
  # therefore path-BLIND on dispatches: it runs in EVERY SM validation
  # (one hosted-macOS leg beside the build-macos/build-ios legs already
  # paid there), and the exzone path set only narrows a future real
  # pull_request trigger. Main/tag/schedule/release runs skip it — the
  # nightly flutter-app-macos leg stays the full-suite backstop there.
  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  flutter-app-exzone:
    name: Exclusion zone (macOS JS-engine tests)
    runs-on: macos-latest
    needs: changes
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && needs.changes.outputs.exzone == 'true') ||
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      # Same SDK incantation as the nightly flutter-app-macos leg.
      - uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          cache: true
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF
      - run: cp flutter_app/firebase_options.template.dart flutter_app/lib/firebase_options.dart
      - uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # engine-dependent tests RUN here instead of skipping as on ubuntu.
      - name: flutter test test/apps (JS engine live)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: flutter test --exclude-tags integration test/apps
