{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

In the engine test file I wrote `test('...', () {...})` without skip for the plain ones and `testWidgets('...', (tester) async {...})` for the bridge-gated one — let me check how I wrote it there... In js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart, the bridge-gated testWidgets has NO skip parameter! Let me check: I wrote `testWidgets('live world after start...', (tester) async {` — no skip. That's a bug in my UT file — must add skip there too.

No — named args must come... in Dart, named arguments can appear in any order relative to each other, but positional arguments must precede... actually no: in Dart you can interleave? Standard pattern: `testWidgets('desc', (tester) async {...}, skip: _engineSkip);` — closure as the last positional, named args after. Let me check how existing repo files do it.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

{"path":"outputs/rca.md","content":"# Root Cause Analysis — gh-1441

## Root Cause Analysis

**Bug**: Every `{type:'voxel'}` node in a JS app rendered by the Fa app shows the renderer's "Voxel world" placeholder (`Icons.landscape`) instead of the bridge-owned voxel world, even though the engine side reports success (`voxel.attach`/`voxel.mesh` resolve, `native=true` in the HUD).

**Root cause**: The Fa app constructs `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without the `voxelWorld` parameter** at both of its construction sites:
- fullscreen surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart` `_treeView` (~line 833);
- live-tile surface: `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart` `DynamicWidgetCanvas` build (~line 376).

The runtime's renderer falls back to `_mediaPlaceholder(m, Icons.landscape, label: 'Voxel world')` exactly when `voxelWorld == null` (`json_widget_renderer.dart` `_voxel`, upstream `js_widget_runtime` 0.4.156). The world exists — `JsWidgetBridge` creates it eagerly at engine start (`js_widget_bridge.dart:134`) and `JsWidgetEngine` already exposes it (`js_widget_engine_wrapper.dart:77`, `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld`) — but Fa's wrapper `JsAppEngine` keeps the runtime engine private (`js_app_engine.dart:307`) and offers no accessor, so the surfaces have nothing to pass.

The bug was exposed (not caused) by the gh-1341 fix: with `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 the widgets' `voxel.*` probes resolve, so fa-craft and voxel-sandbox take the native voxel path — and land on the placeholder ("fast but invisible").

**Impact**: All voxel-bearing JS apps (fa-craft 0.2.18, voxel-sandbox 1.0.0) render a placeholder on every Fa surface while their HUDs/status rows claim the node is live — pixels contradict the engine state, with no diagnostic telling "host did not wire voxelWorld" apart from "broken widget".

**Fix approach** (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring comments — "the SAME host the engine's JsRuntimeConfig got"):
1. `js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` (null before start / after dispose — reload then naturally re-wires the CURRENT world, AC5).
2. `js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `_treeView` renderer construction.
3. `dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` at the `DynamicWidgetCanvas` renderer construction.
4. Degradation contract (AC3): when a tree carries a `voxel` node while the wired world is null (minimal custom backend), keep the renderer's placeholder path and emit a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so authoring agents can tell "host did not wire voxelWorld" from "broken widget".

**Previous attempt**: none — first fix for gh-1441.

## Test plan mapping

- REG-1 (guard): `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` — static source scan asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and that `JsAppEngine` exposes the getter (fails before the fix — the reproduction test).
- UT-1/AC5 + AC3: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` — getter null before start/after dispose, identity across restart (new world, never stale), one-shot missing-world diagnostic (log record asserted via `AppLog.dump()`), null-world placeholder renders without crash.
- IT-1/AC1+E1: `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` — real engine (bridge-gated) + voxel fixture through the `JsAppView` body: `find.byType(JsVoxelNode)`, no landscape placeholder; also bare `{type:'voxel'}` with zero chunks renders the node (eager bridge world).
- IT-2/AC2: `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` — same fixture through the live-tile canvas (`DynamicWidgetTile` + `debugAdd` of a started engine).

Engine-dependent tests are gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern, issue #184); on this Linux runner they run with `LIBQUICKJSC_TEST_PATH` pointing at the flutter_js QuickJS bridge, on CI macOS (JSC) they run natively, on bare ubuntu they skip.

arguments.content:
### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,

{"content":"### Root Cause

`voxel` nodes render the "Voxel world" placeholder because the Fa app built `JsonWidgetRenderer` **without `voxelWorld`** at both construction sites — the fullscreen view (`js_app_view.dart` `_treeView`) and the live tile (`dynamic_widget_tile.dart`). The runtime falls back to the `Icons.landscape` placeholder exactly when the world is null, so `fa-craft`/`voxel-sandbox` resolved their `voxel.*` probes and uploaded meshes while the screen showed the placeholder (exposed by the gh-1341 `js_widget_runtime` ^0.4.156 pin, which made the widgets' probes resolve).

### Fix

- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_engine.dart`: expose `JsVoxelWorld? get voxelWorld => _engine?.voxelWorld;` — always the CURRENT engine's bridge-owned world (null before start / after dispose, so a reload re-wires, never a stale world). Plus `noteUnwiredVoxelWorld(tree)`: a one-shot `AppLog` diagnostic so a null world on a voxel tree reads as "host wiring", not "broken widget".
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/js_app_view.dart`: pass `voxelWorld: engine.voxelWorld` (mirrors the existing `webViewHost`/`js3dHost` wiring) + the diagnostic call.
- `flutter_app/lib/apps/dynamic_widget_tile.dart`: same wiring in `DynamicWidgetCanvas`.

### Test Coverage

- `test/jsr_voxel_world_pin_guard_test.dart` (REG-1): static guard asserting every `JsonWidgetRenderer(` in both surfaces passes `voxelWorld:` and the getter delegates to `_engine` — **failed before the fix** (reproduction), blocks merge even when widget tests skip.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_engine_voxel_world_test.dart` (UT-1/AC5+AC3): world identity across restart, null before start/after dispose; one-shot diagnostic asserted via `AppLog.dump()`; null-world placeholder still renders without crash.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/js_app_view_voxel_test.dart` (IT-1/AC1+E1): real-engine boot through `JsAppView` — `JsVoxelNode` present, placeholder absent; bare first-tree voxel node (zero `voxel.*` calls) renders via the eager bridge world.
- `flutter_app/test/apps/dynamic_widget_tile_voxel_test.dart` (IT-2/AC2): same assertions through the tile canvas.
- Engine-dependent legs gated on `quickJsBridgeAvailable` (repo pattern): live-verified on Linux QuickJS, run on the CI macOS exzone leg, skip on bare ubuntu.

### Notes

- Degradation contract (AC3) kept: a world-less engine still renders the renderer's placeholder; shipped backends always have a world, so the diagnostic never fires there.
- AC4 catalog-app E2E goldens (`fa-craft`, `voxel-sandbox`) are not executable in this runner — the fixtures live in the remote catalog; the IT tests replicate their exact probe → upload → camera protocol instead.
- REG-2 backend parity: the getter is backend-agnostic; the live-world leg covers the native flutter_js backend (QuickJS here, JSC on macOS CI). The web-worker backend is upstream-owned and not loadable in `flutter_test` on this runner.

# Changelog

## 1.0.508


- feat(providers): issue #1398 — stall-recovery tuning becomes per-provider
  and data-driven. Registry entries (`customProviders:`, `models.custom:`,
  roles chain entries, `providersQueue:` entries) accept optional
  `connectTimeoutMs`/`streamIdleTimeoutMs` (strict positive-int parsing);
  resolution is **entry > the `providerTimeouts:` section > the 180 s/300 s
  defaults**, per field, and every seeded entry prints its effective values
  at boot. The wire seams (`sendWatchedProviderRequest` connect watchdog,
  `createSseIterator` idle watchdog) resolve per request URL, so all
  adapters inherit the tuning; runs without entries are byte-identical
  (AC6). Also: the retry backoff contract — a parseable delta-seconds
  `Retry-After` wins over the ladder for that attempt, hard-capped at the
  60 s ceiling (the clamp names the advertised value; `0` counts as
  absent, malformed/HTTP-date headers fall back to the ladder with a trace
  note) — and the dual retry budgets (connection-class cap 4, stream-class
  cap 3, independent counters, the terminal story carries both). Trace
  lines pin the format `budget=<connection|stream> attempt=<n>/<cap>
  delay=<ladder|server|clamp>`; the tuning report prints per-model
  p50/p95 inter-chunk gap + watchdog-fire counts with the
  `streamIdleTimeoutMs ≈ 2× p95` recipe (the production feeder lands with
  #1392's LatencyMeter).
- feat(hosts): gh-1322 — the wireAgentCore host-adoption gaps: an embed
  guide (`docs/embedding.md`, with the explicit "hosts ride wireAgentCore,
  never adk_dart" rule), the host-facing key-slot resolver
  (`AgentCoreServices.resolveKey` + `HostKeyResolver` — the effective slot
  NAME, pinned-twin drift hints identical to the CLI's migration notes,
